native.rule: You may look at the PDFs only with your Read tool, which shows you their pages (pass `pages`, at most 20 pages per call). Do not run any command, script or library on the PDF files.

python.rule: You may touch the PDFs only from Python, run as `{venv}/bin/python`, using the libraries pypdf and pdfplumber and nothing else that reads or writes PDF.

pymupdf4llm.rule: You may touch the PDFs only from Python, run as `{venv}/bin/python`, using the libraries pymupdf4llm and pymupdf (fitz) and nothing else that reads or writes PDF.

pdf_oxide.rule: You may touch the PDFs only from Python, run as `{venv}/bin/python`, using the library pdf_oxide and nothing else that reads or writes PDF. `help(pdf_oxide)` describes it.

liteparse.rule: You may touch the PDFs only with the LiteParse command-line tool, run as `{lit}`, and nothing else that reads or writes PDF. `{lit} --help` describes it.

nupdf.rule: You may touch the PDFs only with the nupdf command-line tool, run as `{nupdf}`, and nothing else that reads or writes PDF. `{nupdf} guide` describes it, and `{nupdf} <command> --help` each command.

nupdf-mcp.rule: You may touch the PDFs only with the tools of the nupdf MCP server (named mcp__nupdf__*), and nothing else that reads or writes PDF.

pymupdf4llm-mcp.rule: You may touch the PDFs only with the tools of the pymupdf4llm MCP server (named mcp__pymupdf4llm__*), and nothing else that reads or writes PDF.

pdf_oxide-mcp.rule: You may touch the PDFs only with the tools of the PDF Oxide MCP server (named mcp__pdf_oxide__*), and nothing else that reads or writes PDF.
